name: @rally/model-pipeline
description: Node-only model pipeline shared by the games: sha256-pinned art packs (Quaternius glTF / OBJ) to small gzipped GLBs. Flat material colours become vertex colours, primitives merge, meshes are welded, simplified (meshoptimizer) and split flat again; clips are reduced and shared; skeletal clips can be baked into bone matrices; a meta module is generated for the game.
